unlisted_practices: Extend AI capabilities to under-represented regions through targeted infrastructure investment and mobile health technologies.
Develop sustainable interdisciplinary training programmes integrating epidemiology, data science, and AI.
Establish national data standardisation frameworks to enable efficient cohort data collection and interoperability across healthcare systems.
Develop comprehensive regulatory validation standards for AI applications in cohort research to uphold scientific rigour and mitigate bias amplification in under-represented populations.
